# Hygiene

> Hygiene is a free, local, read-only scanner for stale instructions and argument residue in AI-assisted repositories. It uses explicit heuristics, Bash, and Git. It makes no model calls and sends no repository data to a service.

## Primary resources

- [Source and documentation](https://github.com/nouvic/hygiene)
- [Why Hygiene exists](https://github.com/nouvic/hygiene#why-this-exists)
- [Demonstration](https://github.com/nouvic/hygiene/blob/main/docs/demo.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/nouvic/hygiene/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/nouvic/hygiene/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Scan feedback](https://github.com/nouvic/hygiene/issues/new?template=scan-feedback.md)

## Scope

Hygiene reports candidates for human review. A finding is not a verdict, and a clean scan only means the current patterns and exemptions produced no matches. The scan command writes nothing and always exits zero.
